name: Harpacochampsa
isnote: Treated as a tomistomine in the literature cited by English Wikipedia and as a gavialoid in PBDB; the tomistomine/gavialoid affinity of this group is debated; placed in Gavialoidea.
sum: Harpacochampsa is a poorly known gavial-like crocodilian from the Miocene of the Northern Territory, Australia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A partial skull and fragments of a long, slender snout.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Megirian et al. 1991

sources.text: Megirian, D.; Murray, P.F.; Willis, P. 1991. A new crocodile of the gavial ecomorph morphology from the Miocene of northern Australia. Beagle: Records of the Museums and Art Galleries of the Northern Territory 8: 135–157. doi:10.5962/p.262817
